scanNote:
6-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (44-bet).

Yuqorida chapda PUShTI-QIZIL yorliqda oq '6' va 'Food, Glorious Food'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
17) 'What should a good fast-food restaurant have? Put a tick (✓) for the good points, and a cross (✗) for the bad points. Then, choose the points you think are most important and talk about them, as in the example.'
   Ko'k qiya namuna: 'FIRSTLY, a good fast-food restaurant should have ... . SECONDLY, it should have ... . THIRDLY, it should have ... . HOWEVER, a good fast-food restaurant should definitely not have ... .'
   15 ta katakchali band: a varied menu, a large salad bar, fast service, dirty toilets, delicious food, a wide choice of vegetarian dishes, high prices, helpful friendly staff, smart uniforms, slow service, good music, clean tables, rude waiters, comfortable seating, a no-smoking policy.
18) a) Qiya: 'Mr Harris visited Monty's fast-food restaurant to write a report about its good and bad points.' Qalin: 'Read his report and fill in the missing headings from the list.' Qiya ro'yxat: Food & Prices, Atmosphere, Introduction, Conclusion, Service.
    b) 'What good/bad points does Mr Harris mention in his report? What solutions does he suggest? Which modal verb does he use for his suggestions?'

O'NG USTUN:
• Yuqorida SURAT: tez ovqat restoranida qora ko'ylakdagi yigit peshtaxta ortida oq ko'ylakdagi qizga patnisda xot-dog va kartoshka fri uzatmoqda.
• HISOBOT (yirtiq qog'oz shaklida, qiyshaygan, kulrang fonda, 5 ta raqamli xatboshi, har birida nuqtali sarlavha joyi):
  1 ......... The purpose of this report is to assess the new Monty's fast-food restaurant in Chester, which I visited on 28th June.
  2 ......... There is a varied menu at Monty's which includes a fantastic salad bar, a wide choice of vegetarian dishes and five types of delicious hamburgers. I tried the Mexican Sizzler - a spicy hamburger with chilli sauce in a soft, white bread roll. It was very tasty. However, it was rather cold. I also thought that Monty's was a bit too expensive.
  3 ......... The Monty's staff were helpful, friendly and polite during my visit. They looked very smart in their clean uniforms. Unfortunately, the service was rather slow and one of the cashiers gave me the wrong change.
  4 ......... The friendly staff, good music, clean tables, and comfortable seating all helped to give Monty's an excellent atmosphere. The new no-smoking policy is also a good idea, and it made my meal at Monty's a very pleasurable experience.
  5 ......... The new Monty's restaurant in Chester is, on the whole, a great success. However, I think that the manager should make a few improvements. Firstly, he should make sure that all hot dishes are hot when they go out to customers. Secondly, he should lower the prices, as they are too high for a fast-food restaurant. Finally, he should improve staff training, so that the staff work faster and make fewer mistakes.
19) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the sentences, then listen and write T (for true) or F (for false).' Besh gap, nuqtali joylar:
   1 There is a varied menu at Monty's. 2 Monty's was a bit too cheap. 3 The Monty's staff were helpful, friendly and polite. 4 The new no-smoking policy is also a bad idea. 5 The manager should make no improvements.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the report in Ex. 18 again and make notes under these headings. Then, use your notes to talk about Monty's.' Uch ko'k sarlavha: • good points • bad points • suggestions

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '44'.

exercises.instructionEn: What should a good fast-food restaurant have? Put a tick (✓) for the good points, and a cross (✗) for the bad points.
exercises.instructionUz: Yaxshi tez ovqat restoranida nima bo'lishi kerak? Yaxshi tomonlarga ✓, yomon tomonlarga ✗ qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
15 BAND - YaXShI va YoMON.


YaXShI (✓):
  a varied menu - turli-tuman menyu
  a large salad bar - katta salat
     bo'limi
  fast service - tez xizmat
  delicious food - mazali ovqat
  a wide choice of vegetarian
     dishes - vegetarian taomlarning
     keng tanlovi
  helpful, friendly staff - yordamchi,
     samimiy xodimlar
  smart uniforms - chiroyli forma
  good music - yaxshi musiqa
  clean tables - toza stollar
  comfortable seating - qulay
     o'rindiqlar
  a no-smoking policy - chekish
     taqiqi

YoMON (✗):
  dirty toilets - iflos hojatxona
  high prices - yuqori narxlar
  slow service - sekin xizmat
  rude waiters - qo'pol ofitsiantlar


⚠ 'STAFF' - JAMOA OTI:

  = xodimlar (hammasi birga).
  ⚠ Britaniyada KO'PLIK fe'l bilan:
  'The staff WERE helpful.'
  ⚠ 'a staff' - XATO; 'a member of
  staff' ✓.


⚠ 'SMART' - BRITANIYaDA:

  = chiroyli, ozoda kiyingan.
  ⚠ 'aqlli' ma'nosi ham bor, lekin
  kiyim haqida = ozoda.


⚠ 'SEATING':

  = o'rindiqlar (umumiy).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.
  ⚠ 'a seat' = bitta o'rindiq.


⚠ 'A NO-SMOKING POLICY':

  = chekish taqiqi qoidasi.
  ⚠ 'policy' = siyosat, qoida.
  ⚠ DEFIS bilan.


⚠ 'RUDE':

  = qo'pol.
  ⚠ Aksi: 'polite' = muloyim.


⚠ 'VARIED':

  = turli-tuman.
  ⚠ 'to vary' = o'zgarmoq, turlicha
  bo'lmoq; 'variety' = xilma-xillik.

items.textEn: a wide choice of vegetarian dishes

exercises.instructionEn: Then, choose the points you think are most important and talk about them, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng eng muhim deb hisoblagan bandlarni tanlab, ular haqida namunadagidek gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'FIRSTLY, a good fast-food restaurant
   should have ... . SECONDLY, it
   should have ... . THIRDLY, it should
   have ... . HOWEVER, a good fast-food
   restaurant should definitely not
   have ... .'


⚠ TARTIB SO'ZLARI:

  Firstly - birinchidan
  Secondly - ikkinchidan
  Thirdly - uchinchidan
  Finally - nihoyat

  ⚠ Har birining oxirida VERGUL.


⚠ 'HOWEVER':

  = lekin, biroq (RASMIY 'but').
  ⚠ Gap boshida, oxirida VERGUL.


⚠ 'DEFINITELY':

  = albatta, aniq.
  ⚠ Imlosi qiyin: d-e-f-i-n-i-t-e-l-y
  ('definately' - XATO!).


⚠ 'SHOULD NOT HAVE':

  'should DEFINITELY not have' -
  'definitely' 'should' bilan 'not'
  orasiga tushadi.
exercises.exampleEn: Firstly, a good fast-food restaurant should have fast service.
exercises.exampleUz: Birinchidan, yaxshi tez ovqat restoranida tez xizmat bo'lishi kerak.
modelAnswers: Firstly, a good fast-food restaurant should have fast service.
Secondly, it should have delicious food.
Thirdly, it should have helpful, friendly staff and clean tables.
However, a good fast-food restaurant should definitely not have high prices or dirty toilets.
modelAnswersUz: Birinchidan, yaxshi tez ovqat restoranida tez xizmat bo'lishi kerak.
Ikkinchidan, unda mazali ovqat bo'lishi kerak.
Uchinchidan, unda yordamchi, samimiy xodimlar va toza stollar bo'lishi kerak.
Biroq, yaxshi tez ovqat restoranida albatta yuqori narxlar yoki iflos hojatxona bo'lmasligi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Mr Harris visited Monty's fast-food restaurant to write a report about its good and bad points.
exercises.instructionUz: Janob Harris Monty's tez ovqat restoraniga uning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari haqida hisobot yozish uchun bordi.
exercises.explanationUz:
HISOBOT - TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI.


⚠ 'A REPORT':

  = hisobot.
  ⚠ Rasmiy uslub, SARLAVHALI
  xatboshilar (Introduction, ...,
  Conclusion).


⚠ HISOBOT TUZILIShI:

  1 Introduction - maqsad
  2-4 Asosiy qism - har mavzu
      alohida sarlavha ostida
  5 Conclusion - xulosa va
      tavsiyalar


⚠ 'MONTY'S':

  = Monty(ning) restorani.
  ⚠ Egalik apostrofi bilan restoran
  nomi: 'at Monty's'.
  ⚠ 'McDonald's' ham shunday.


⚠ 'THE MEXICAN SIZZLER':

  Gamburger nomi. 'to sizzle' =
  jizillamoq (qovurilganda).


⚠ 'RATHER' va 'A BIT':

  rather cold = ancha sovuq
  a bit too expensive = biroz
     qimmatroq
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham tanqidni
  YUMShATADI - rasmiy uslub.

points.en: [1 Introduction] The purpose of this report is to assess the new Monty's fast-food restaurant in Chester, which I visited on 28th June.
points.uz: [1 Kirish] Bu hisobotning maqsadi - men 28-iyunda borgan Chesterdagi yangi Monty's tez ovqat restoranini baholash.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'The purpose of this report is to ...' -
hisobotning STANDART boshlanishi.
⚠ 'to assess' = baholamoq.
⚠ ', which I visited' - aniqlovchi ergash gap.

points.en: [2 Food & Prices] There is a varied menu at Monty's which includes a fantastic salad bar, a wide choice of vegetarian dishes and five types of delicious hamburgers.
points.uz: [2 Ovqat va narxlar] Monty's da turli-tuman menyu bor: ajoyib salat bo'limi, vegetarian taomlarning keng tanlovi va besh xil mazali gamburger.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to include' = o'z ichiga olmoq.
⚠ 'five types OF hamburgers'.

points.en: I tried the Mexican Sizzler - a spicy hamburger with chilli sauce in a soft, white bread roll. It was very tasty. However, it was rather cold. I also thought that Monty's was a bit too expensive.
points.uz: Men 'Mexican Sizzler'ni tatib ko'rdim - yumshoq oq bulochkada chili sousli achchiq gamburger. Juda mazali edi. Biroq, ancha sovuq edi. Menimcha, Monty's biroz qimmatroq ham edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'spicy' = achchiq (ziravorli).
⚠ 'However' - YoMON tomonga o'tish.
⚠ 'rather cold', 'a bit too expensive' -
yumshatilgan tanqid.

points.en: [3 Service] The Monty's staff were helpful, friendly and polite during my visit. They looked very smart in their clean uniforms. Unfortunately, the service was rather slow and one of the cashiers gave me the wrong change.
points.uz: [3 Xizmat] Tashrifim davomida Monty's xodimlari yordamchi, samimiy va muloyim edi. Toza formalarida juda chiroyli ko'rinardi. Afsuski, xizmat ancha sekin edi va kassirlardan biri qaytimni noto'g'ri berdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'The staff WERE' - jamoa oti, ko'plik fe'l.
⚠ 'Unfortunately' = afsuski.
⚠ 'change' bu yerda = qaytim pul.
⚠ 'a cashier' = kassir.

points.en: [4 Atmosphere] The friendly staff, good music, clean tables, and comfortable seating all helped to give Monty's an excellent atmosphere. The new no-smoking policy is also a good idea, and it made my meal at Monty's a very pleasurable experience.
points.uz: [4 Muhit] Samimiy xodimlar, yaxshi musiqa, toza stollar va qulay o'rindiqlar - hammasi Monty's ga ajoyib muhit berdi. Yangi chekish taqiqi ham yaxshi fikr va u Monty's dagi ovqatimni juda yoqimli tajribaga aylantirdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'atmosphere' = muhit, /ˈætməsfɪə/.
⚠ 'pleasurable' = yoqimli (rasmiy).
⚠ 'to help TO give' - 'help' dan keyin 'to'
ixtiyoriy.

points.en: [5 Conclusion] The new Monty's restaurant in Chester is, on the whole, a great success. However, I think that the manager should make a few improvements.
points.uz: [5 Xulosa] Chesterdagi yangi Monty's restorani, umuman olganda, katta muvaffaqiyat. Biroq, menimcha, menejer bir nechta yaxshilanish kiritishi kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'on the whole' = umuman olganda.
⚠ 'SHOULD make' - tavsiya uchun modal fe'l
(18b savoli).
⚠ 'an improvement' = yaxshilanish.

points.en: Firstly, he should make sure that all hot dishes are hot when they go out to customers. Secondly, he should lower the prices, as they are too high for a fast-food restaurant. Finally, he should improve staff training, so that the staff work faster and make fewer mistakes.
points.uz: Birinchidan, u barcha issiq taomlar mijozlarga chiqarilganda issiq bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilishi kerak. Ikkinchidan, narxlarni tushirishi kerak, chunki ular tez ovqat restorani uchun juda yuqori. Nihoyat, xodimlar tayyorgarligini yaxshilashi kerak, shunda xodimlar tezroq ishlaydi va kamroq xato qiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to make sure that' = ishonch hosil qilmoq.
⚠ 'to lower' = tushirmoq (narxni).
⚠ 'FEWER mistakes' - sanaladigan ot bilan
'fewer' ('less' EMAS!).
⚠ 'so that' = shunda, ... uchun.

exercises.instructionEn: Read his report and fill in the missing headings from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Uning hisobotini o'qing va ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan sarlavhalarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SARLAVHA - BESh XATBOShI.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 → INTRODUCTION
    ('The purpose of this report is
     to ...')
  2 → FOOD & PRICES
    (menu, hamburgers, expensive)
  3 → SERVICE
    (staff, slow, cashier)
  4 → ATMOSPHERE
    (music, tables, seating,
     no-smoking)
  5 → CONCLUSION
    ('on the whole', improvements)


⚠ SARLAVHANI QANDAY TOPISh:

  Xatboshining KALIT SO'ZLARIGA
  qarang: 'menu, prices' → Food &
  Prices; 'staff, service' → Service.


⚠ 'INTRODUCTION' va 'CONCLUSION':

  introduction = kirish
  conclusion = xulosa
  ⚠ Har hisobot/insho shu ikkisi
  bilan boshlanib tugaydi.

pairs.left: 1 The purpose of this report is to assess ...
2 There is a varied menu ... a bit too expensive.
3 The Monty's staff were helpful ... the wrong change.
4 The friendly staff, good music, clean tables ... a very pleasurable experience.
pairs.leftUz: Samimiy xodimlar, musiqa, toza stollar ... yoqimli tajriba
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Matnda so'zning o'zi bor: 'an excellent
ATMOSPHERE'.

pairs.left: 5 The new Monty's restaurant ... is, on the whole, a great success.
pairs.leftUz: Yangi restoran ... umuman olganda, katta muvaffaqiyat

exercises.instructionEn: What good/bad points does Mr Harris mention in his report? What solutions does he suggest? Which modal verb does he use for his suggestions?
exercises.instructionUz: Janob Harris hisobotida qanday yaxshi/yomon tomonlarni eslatadi? Qanday yechimlar taklif qiladi? Takliflari uchun qaysi modal fe'lni ishlatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ MODAL FE'L: SHOULD.

  'he SHOULD make sure ...'
  'he SHOULD lower the prices'
  'he SHOULD improve staff training'

  ⚠ 43-betdagi qoida: should =
  maslahat/tavsiya.


⚠ 'A SOLUTION':

  = yechim.
  ⚠ 'to solve' = yechmoq, hal qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO SUGGEST':

  = taklif qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'a suggestion' = taklif.
  ⚠ 'suggest TO do' - XATO;
  'suggest doING' ✓.

items.en: What good points does Mr Harris mention?
items.uz: Janob Harris qanday yaxshi tomonlarni eslatadi?
items.answerEn: A varied menu, a fantastic salad bar, a wide choice of vegetarian dishes, delicious hamburgers, helpful and friendly staff, smart uniforms, good music, clean tables, comfortable seating and a no-smoking policy.
items.answerUz: Turli-tuman menyu, ajoyib salat bo'limi, vegetarian taomlarning keng tanlovi, mazali gamburgerlar, yordamchi va samimiy xodimlar, chiroyli forma, yaxshi musiqa, toza stollar, qulay o'rindiqlar va chekish taqiqi.

items.en: What bad points does he mention?
items.answerEn: The hamburger was rather cold, the restaurant was a bit too expensive, the service was slow and a cashier gave him the wrong change.
items.answerUz: Gamburger ancha sovuq edi, restoran biroz qimmatroq edi, xizmat sekin edi va kassir qaytimni noto'g'ri berdi.

items.answerEn: The manager should make sure hot dishes are hot, lower the prices and improve staff training.
items.answerUz: Menejer issiq taomlar issiq bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilishi, narxlarni tushirishi va xodimlar tayyorgarligini yaxshilashi kerak.

items.en: Which modal verb does he use for his suggestions?
items.uz: Takliflari uchun qaysi modal fe'lni ishlatadi?

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences, then listen and write T (for true) or F (for false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing, so'ng tinglang va T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio bor, lekin javoblar
HISOBOTDAN aniq.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 T - 'There is a varied menu'
  2 F - 'a bit too EXPENSIVE'
      (cheap EMAS)
  3 T - 'helpful, friendly and polite'
  4 F - no-smoking policy 'a GOOD
      idea' (bad EMAS)
  5 F - 'should make A FEW
      improvements' (no EMAS)


⚠ TUZOQ USULI:

  Noto'g'ri gaplar matndagi so'zni
  QARAMA-QARShISIGA almashtirgan:
     expensive → cheap
     good → bad
     a few → no

⚠ Hisobotda: 'There is a varied menu at
Monty's'.

⚠ Hisobotda: 'a bit too EXPENSIVE' - qimmat,
arzon emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the report in Ex. 18 again and make notes under these headings: good points, bad points, suggestions. Then, use your notes to talk about Monty's.
exercises.instructionUz: 18-mashqdagi hisobotni qayta o'qing va shu sarlavhalar ostida qayd oling: yaxshi tomonlar, yomon tomonlar, takliflar. So'ng qaydlaringizdan foydalanib Monty's haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  GOOD POINTS:
    varied menu, salad bar, vegetarian
    dishes, tasty hamburgers, friendly
    staff, smart uniforms, good music,
    clean tables, comfortable seating,
    no-smoking policy

  BAD POINTS:
    hamburger cold, too expensive,
    slow service, wrong change

  SUGGESTIONS:
    hot dishes hot, lower prices,
    improve staff training


⚠ GAPIRISh QOLIPI:

  'Monty's has ... . However, ... .
   The manager should ... .'
exercises.exampleEn: Monty's has a varied menu and friendly staff.
exercises.exampleUz: Monty's da turli-tuman menyu va samimiy xodimlar bor.
modelAnswers: Monty's has a varied menu, a fantastic salad bar and delicious hamburgers.
The staff are helpful and friendly, and the atmosphere is excellent.
However, the food was rather cold and the prices are too high.
The service was slow and a cashier gave the wrong change.
The manager should make sure the food is hot, lower the prices and improve staff training.
modelAnswersUz: Monty's da turli-tuman menyu, ajoyib salat bo'limi va mazali gamburgerlar bor.
Xodimlar yordamchi va samimiy, muhit esa ajoyib.
Biroq, ovqat ancha sovuq edi va narxlar juda yuqori.
Xizmat sekin edi va kassir qaytimni noto'g'ri berdi.
Menejer ovqat issiq bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qilishi, narxlarni tushirishi va xodimlar tayyorgarligini yaxshilashi kerak.

patterns.exampleEn: Firstly, a good restaurant should have fast service. However, it should not have high prices.
patterns.exampleUz: Birinchidan, yaxshi restoranda tez xizmat bo'lishi kerak. Biroq, yuqori narxlar bo'lmasligi kerak.

patterns.exampleUz: Bu hisobotning maqsadi - yangi restoranni baholash.

patterns.exampleEn: He should lower the prices, as they are too high.
patterns.exampleUz: U narxlarni tushirishi kerak, chunki ular juda yuqori.
